# Kimi Code Overview | Kimi Code Docs

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#VPContent)

On this page

Kimi Code Overview [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#kimi-code-overview)

==============================================================================

What is Kimi Code [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#what-is-kimi-code)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code is an intelligent programming service for developers included in [Kimi membership benefits](https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing?from=kfc_docs_overview)
. Built on Kimi's latest flagship models, it provides AI-assisted capabilities—such as code reading, file editing, and command execution—through product forms like the Desktop app, CLI, and VS Code extension. Subscribers can also obtain an API Key to integrate Kimi Code's model capabilities into third-party development tools and platforms.

Core Advantages [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#core-advantages)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

**1\. Models and inference**

Flagship K3 modelPowered by our strongest flagship model K3 — 2.8 trillion parameters — excelling at long-horizon programming, front-end visual design, knowledge work, and complex reasoning.

1M-token context windowA million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.

260 tokens/s inferenceChoose between the standard K2.8 Preview and the K2.7 Code HighSpeed tier, with output up to 260 tokens/s for a noticeably faster coding loop.

**2\. Ecosystem and extensibility**

Professional data sourcesPlug in professional-grade data sources to extend what AI coding can do.

Works with mainstream toolsCompatible with Kimi Code CLI, Claude Code, VS Code, and other mainstream agent tools — switch models seamlessly.

Early access to experimental featuresBe first to try Kimi's latest model and inference capabilities as they land.

Getting Started [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#getting-started)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code allows members to use their benefits in both the official client and third-party platforms, covering different development scenarios.

### Using the Official Client [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#using-the-official-client)

Choose the client that fits you and install with one click:

Kimi Code DesktopKimi Code CLIKimi Code for VS Code

For developers who prefer a graphical app. Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation. Available on macOS and Windows.

[Kimi Code DesktopmacOS · Apple Silicon](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-arm64.dmg)
[Kimi Code DesktopmacOS · Intel](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-x64.dmg)
[Kimi Code DesktopWindows](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-win-x64.exe)

After installing, open the app and sign in with your Kimi account as prompted—no API Key management needed. See [Desktop Quick Start](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-desktop/getting-started.html)
 for more.

For developers who prefer terminal operations. Chat with AI in the terminal, letting it read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks.

📢 CLI Upgraded

Kimi Code CLI has gone through a major version upgrade — moving from Python/uv to Node.js, bringing a simpler install experience, faster startup, and a redesigned terminal UI. The legacy version will no longer be maintained. See [Version Upgrade](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code-cli/guides/migration.html)
 for details and migration instructions, or refer to the legacy Python-based Kimi Code [docs](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-cli/en/)
 if needed.

bash

    # macOS / Linux
    curl -fsSL https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh | bash

powershell

    # Windows (PowerShell)
    irm https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.ps1 | iex

After installation, run `kimi` in the terminal to start; on first use, log in to the Kimi Code platform with the `/login` command to complete the connection — no need to manually manage an API Key.

For developers who prefer the VS Code editor. Collaborate with AI in the editor sidebar, supporting code completion, file editing, web search, and automated tasks.

Search for "Kimi Code" in the VS Code Extensions marketplace to install, or visit [Visual Studio Marketplace](vscode:extension/moonshot-ai.kimi-code)
. After installation, complete the connection via the login button in the sidebar — no need to manually manage an API Key.

> If the extension doesn't appear after installation, restart VS Code or run "Developer: Reload Window" from the Command Palette (Mac: Cmd+Shift+P, Windows/Linux: Ctrl+Shift+P).

Other editors such as JetBrains and Zed can connect via CLI's ACP protocol. See [Using Kimi Code CLI in IDEs](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code-cli/guides/ides.html)
 for details.

### API Access [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#api-access)

When integrating Kimi Code into third-party development tools, you need to manually configure an API Key to complete authentication.

#### Service Endpoint [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#service-endpoint)

The Kimi Code API is compatible with both OpenAI and Anthropic protocols. Different tools have different requirements for address configuration:

*   **Base URL**: Some tools (e.g., Claude Code) only require the Base URL, and the tool will automatically append the subsequent path.
*   **Full Endpoint**: Some tools (e.g., Trae) require the complete API request address.

Choose the corresponding address as needed:

| Protocol | Base URL | Common Endpoint Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenAI Compatible | China: `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`  <br>Overseas: `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1` | `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions` |
| Anthropic Compatible | China: `https://api.kimi.com/coding/`  <br>Overseas: `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/` | `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages` |

#### Model IDs [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#model-ids)

Different model IDs correspond to different membership tiers and context windows. See [Membership Benefits](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html)
 for details.

Both protocols accept the following 4 model IDs:

| Model ID | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `k3` | K3 — available to Moderato / Plus members and above; Allegretto / Pro members and above unlock the up-to-1M context window; supports `low` / `high` / `max` thinking effort levels. Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing. |
| `k3-256k` | K3 256K context version — available to Moderato / Plus members and above; supports `low` / `high` / `max` thinking effort levels. Within 256k context, it delivers the same results as K3. `k3` (1M) consumes about twice as much quota as `k3-256k`. Ideal for everyday Q&A, code completion, routine feature development, and single-file or small-file edits — video input is not supported. |
| `kimi-for-coding` | K2.8 Preview — available to Andante / Plus members and above; supports up to 1M context and `low` / `high` / `max` reasoning effort. |
| `kimi-for-coding-highspeed` | K2.7 Code HighSpeed — available to Allegretto / Pro members and above. |

See [Model configuration](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html)
 for model capabilities and setup details.

#### Obtaining an API Key [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#obtaining-an-api-key)

Kimi members can create and manage API Keys in the [Kimi Code Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/console)
 (up to 5 keys; each is shown only once upon creation—please keep it safe).

#### Configuring in Third-Party Tools [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/#configuring-in-third-party-tools)

After obtaining an API Key, configure the corresponding Base URL and API Key in the environment variables of the respective tool to start using it. For detailed setup steps, see the corresponding tool guide:

[Claude CodeAnthropic's command-line coding assistant](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/claude-code)
[OpenCodeA terminal-based coding agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/opencode)
[CodexOpenAI's coding agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/codex)

> **Note**: Please maintain the tool's real identity identifier when using. Tampering with the client identifier (User-Agent) is considered a violation and may result in suspension of membership benefits.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code membership benefits are designed specifically for programming scenarios. If you need to call large model capabilities in your own product, or require team collaboration and usage management, please visit the [Kimi Platform](https://platform.kimi.ai/)
.

# Model Configuration | Kimi Code Docs

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#VPContent)

On this page

Model Configuration [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#model-configuration)

=====================================================================================================

This page covers the models Kimi Code provides and how to switch between them in each client.

Model Overview [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#model-overview)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code currently offers three models—K3, K2.8 Preview, and K2.7 Code HighSpeed—across four model IDs, selectable by model ID in clients or third-party tools. Model specs:

Recommended model launch

**K2.8 Preview** is now fully rolled out in Kimi Code — `kimi-for-coding` is upgraded in place with no configuration changes: performance close to K3, with `low` / `high` / `max` thinking effort levels and up to 1M context. See [What's New](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html)
.

| Model ID | `k3` | `k3-256k` | `kimi-for-coding` | `kimi-for-coding-highspeed` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model version | K3  | K3  | K2.8 Preview | K2.7 Code HighSpeed |
| Description | The most capable flagship coding model: 2.8T parameters, 1M context window | The 256K context version of K3 — `k3` (1M) consumes about twice as much quota as `k3-256k` | Performance close to K3 with more efficient thinking; good at code completion and routine development tasks | The high-speed version of K2.7 Code, with the same coding ability and ~5–6× faster output |
| Speed | Regular | Regular | Regular | HighSpeed (6× speed, 3× quota usage) |
| Context window | `1048576` (for higher-tier members) | `262144` only | `1048576` | `262144` |
| Reasoning | `reasoning_effort:low` / `high` / `max`  <br>(default `high`) | `reasoning_effort:low` / `high` / `max` (default `high`) | `reasoning_effort:low` / `high` / `max`  <br>(default `max`) | `Thinking:ON` |
| Availability (new plans) | Plus and above  <br>1M context for Pro and above | Plus and above | Plus and above | Pro and above |
| Availability (legacy plans) | Moderato and above  <br>1M context for Allegretto and above | Moderato and above | Andante and above | Allegretto and above |
| Multimodal input | Image, video | Image only | Image, video | Image, video |

Need a higher membership plan?

Different membership plans unlock different models, context windows, and speeds. [**Upgrade your plan →**](https://www.kimi.com/code/#pricing)

Why did usage go up after the new model launched?

After switching models, the context cache built earlier no longer hits on the new model, so that context has to be re-prefilled. Usage therefore looks higher right after switching. Recommended action:

*   **Start a new session when using the new model**: this gives better results and lower consumption.

Why do I still get a 401 with the correct model ID?

When the requested capability exceeds your plan's entitlements, the server returns `401`. Three common cases:

*   **No K3 access**: your plan is below Moderato / Plus and can't call `k3`, `k3-256k` (the new Go tier has no coding quota) — upgrade to Moderato / Plus or above.
*   **No 1M access**: on a Moderato / Plus plan, `k3` supports up to 256K context; up to 1M context is available on Allegretto / Pro or above. `k3-256k` has a fixed 256K context limit.
*   **No HighSpeed access**: some plans don't include HighSpeed — upgrade to Allegretto / Pro or above to call `kimi-for-coding-highspeed`.

For the full error text and how to handle it, see the [Error Reference](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/error-reference.html)
.

Why isn't HighSpeed noticeably faster?

Two common reasons:

*   **Mistyped model ID**: the HighSpeed ID must be `kimi-for-coding-highspeed`; a wrong value silently falls back to the standard `kimi-for-coding` — no error, no speedup.
*   **Tools and scripts dominate**: HighSpeed only speeds up **model output**. Tool calls (reading/writing files, running commands, etc.) and script execution are unaffected, so when they take up most of a turn the overall speedup feels small.

How to reduce the overhead of switching reasoning effort?

Switching reasoning effort invalidates the context cache you've built up, so context that would have hit the cache must be re-prefilled. To avoid triggering re-prefill too often:

*   Pick an effort that fits the task and keep it consistent within a session;
*   When you genuinely need a different effort, start a new session rather than switching back and forth in a long session.

Switching between K3 (1M) and K3-256k

**Switching from K3 (1M) to K3-256k**: if the current session's context already exceeds 256k, some coding tools (such as Kimi Code CLI and Claude Code) will perform a compact on the tool side. Recommendations:

1.  Manually run compact once before switching to compress the context to within 256k. This preserves the key points of the task, keeps the session intact, and lets you benefit from more durable quota after switching.
2.  If the conversation history includes video files, switching directly will fail because K3-256k does not support video input. Please compact first, then switch.

**Switching from K3-256k to K3 (1M)**: if `k3-256k` is close to the 256k limit and you don't want compact to lose information, you can switch directly to 1M. The current version switching from 256k to 1M does not affect the cache.

How to Switch Models [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#switch-model)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Usage notes

*   **Start a new session when switching model IDs**: switching models invalidates the context cache you've built up. We recommend starting a new session to get the best experience and avoid extra token consumption.
*   **Fill in the Model ID, not the model version name**: when calling a model, use one of the Model IDs from the table above (`k3`, `k3-256k`, `kimi-for-coding`, `kimi-for-coding-highspeed`). Entering a model version name like `K3` or `K2.8 Preview` will cause the call to fail.
*   **Thinking off routes to K2.8 Preview (no thinking)**: with thinking disabled, requests to the K3 series and K2.8 Preview are served by K2.8 Preview with thinking off.

Ways to switch to the target model:

### Official clients [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#official-clients)

*   **Kimi Code Desktop**: switch models in the model picker inside the Composer; if the target model isn't listed yet, restart the app or sign in again.
*   **Official Kimi Code CLI**: type `/model` to switch models—no config changes needed; if the latest model isn't listed yet, `/logout` and sign in again with `/login`.
*   **Kimi Code for VS Code**: pick the target model from the dropdown menu in the input bar; if it isn't listed yet, restart VS Code or reinstall the extension.

### Third-party tools [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html#third-party-tools)

Set the tool's Model ID to the target model. Detailed steps:

1.  Create an API Key in the [Kimi Code Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/console)
    .
2.  Fill in the Base URL and the corresponding Model ID in your tool.

Kimi Code API supports both OpenAI and Anthropic protocols. Base URLs:

| Protocol | Base URL |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI compatible | China `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`  <br>Overseas `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1` |
| Anthropic compatible | China `https://api.kimi.com/coding/`  <br>Overseas `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/` |

For detailed setup steps, see the corresponding tool guide:

[Claude CodeAnthropic's command-line coding assistant](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/claude-code)
[OpenCodeA terminal-based coding agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/opencode)
[CodexOpenAI's coding agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/third-party-tools/codex)

Effort mapping in third-party tools

Both K3 and K2.8 Preview support `low` / `high` / `max` thinking effort levels; the effort a tool sends is mapped as below:

    # default
    null / undefined       → model default (high for K3, max for K2.8 Preview)
    any other unknown       → HTTP 400 error
    
    # → max
    ultra / max / xhigh     → max
    
    # → high (recommended)
    high / medium           → high
    
    # → low
    low / minimum / light   → low
    
    # → thinking disabled
    none                    → thinking.type disabled

# Kimi Code 概览 | Kimi Code 文档

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#VPContent)

On this page

Kimi Code 概览 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#kimi-code-%E6%A6%82%E8%A7%88)

===============================================================================

Kimi Code 是什么 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#kimi-code-%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code 是 [Kimi 会员权益](https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing?from=kfc_docs_overview)
中专为开发者提供的智能编程服务，基于 Kimi 最新旗舰模型，通过桌面端、CLI、VS Code 扩展插件等产品形态，为开发者提供代码阅读、文件编辑、命令执行等 AI 辅助能力。同时，订阅用户可获取 API Key，将 Kimi Code 的模型能力接入到第三方开发工具与平台。

核心优势 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E4%BC%98%E5%8A%BF)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**一、模型与推理**

旗舰 K3 模型搭载最强旗舰模型 K3，参数规模高达 2.8 万亿，在长程编程、前端视觉设计、知识工作与复杂推理等核心场景表现卓越。

1M Tokens 超长上下文支持百万级上下文窗口，可一次性完整载入大型代码库及跨模块依赖，实现全局代码理解与项目级重构。

260 Tokens/s 极速推理提供 K2.8 Preview 普速版与 K2.7 Code HighSpeed 高速版双模式，推理速度最高可达 260 Tokens/s，显著加速编码效率。

**二、扩展与生态**

专业知识库（Data Source）支持接入专业级数据源，深度扩展 AI Coding 能力边界。

主流工具无缝兼容全面兼容 Kimi Code CLI、Claude Code、VS Code 等主流 Agent 工具，模型切换丝滑无感。

实验性功能优先开放优先体验 Kimi 在模型与推理领域的最新技术与产品实现，先人一步触达前沿特性。

开始使用 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code 支持会员在官方客户端和第三方平台使用权益，覆盖不同的开发场景。

### 使用官方客户端 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E5%AE%98%E6%96%B9%E5%AE%A2%E6%88%B7%E7%AB%AF)

选择适合你的客户端，一键安装：

Kimi Code DesktopKimi Code CLIKimi Code for VS Code

适合希望在图形界面中管理项目和会话的开发者。在桌面端中打开本地项目文件夹，与 AI 对话完成代码阅读、文件编辑、命令执行和结果验证，支持 macOS 与 Windows。

[Kimi Code 桌面版macOS · Apple Silicon](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-arm64.dmg)
[Kimi Code 桌面版macOS · Intel](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-x64.dmg)
[Kimi Code 桌面版Windows](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-win-x64.exe)

安装后打开应用，按页面提示登录 Kimi 账号即可开始使用，无需手动管理 API Key。更多说明见[桌面端快速开始](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code-desktop/getting-started.html)
。

适合习惯终端操作的开发者。在终端中与 AI 对话，让它阅读代码、编辑文件、执行命令、搜索网页，自主完成开发任务。

📢 CLI 已升级

Kimi Code CLI 已完成重大版本升级，底层从 Python/uv 迁移至 Node.js，带来更简单的安装方式、更快的启动速度和全新的终端界面。旧版将不再维护。查看 [版本升级](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code-cli/guides/migration.html)
 了解详情和迁移方式，如需参考旧版内容，请查阅 Python 版 Kimi Code [文档站](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-cli/zh/)
。

bash

    # macOS / Linux
    curl -fsSL https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh | bash

powershell

    # Windows (PowerShell)
    irm https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.ps1 | iex

安装完成后，在终端中运行 `kimi` 启动，首次使用通过 `/login` 命令登录 Kimi Code 平台即完成接入，无需手动管理 API Key。

适合偏好使用 VS Code 编辑器的开发者。在编辑器侧边栏与 AI 协同，支持代码补全、文件编辑、网页搜索和自动化任务。

在 VS Code 扩展市场搜索 "Kimi Code" 安装，或访问 [Visual Studio Marketplace](vscode:extension/moonshot-ai.kimi-code)
。安装后通过侧边栏的登录按钮完成接入，无需手动管理 API Key。

> 若安装后未显示扩展，请重启 VS Code 或在命令面板中执行 "Developer: Reload Window" (Mac: Cmd+Shift+P, Windows/Linux: Ctrl+Shift+P)。

其他编辑器如 JetBrains、Zed 可通过 CLI 的 ACP 协议接入使用，详见 [在 IDE 中使用](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code-cli/guides/ides.html)
。

### API 接入 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#api-%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5)

将 Kimi Code 接入第三方开发工具时，需要手动配置 API Key 完成认证。

#### 服务地址 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80)

Kimi Code API 同时兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 两种协议。不同工具对地址配置的要求不同：

*   **Base URL**：部分工具（如 Claude Code）只需填写 Base URL，工具会自动拼接后续路径。
*   **完整 Endpoint**：部分工具（如 Trae）需要填写完整的 API 请求地址。

按需选择对应的地址：

| 协议  | Base URL | 常用 Endpoint 示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenAI 兼容 | 国内：`https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`  <br>海外：`https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1` | `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/chat/completions` |
| Anthropic 兼容 | 国内：`https://api.kimi.com/coding/`  <br>海外：`https://api.kimi.ai/coding/` | `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/messages` |

#### 模型 ID [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B-id)

不同模型 ID 对应不同的会员档位与上下文窗口，具体权益见 [会员权益](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code/membership.html)
。

两种协议均可使用以下 4 个模型 ID：

| Model ID | 说明  |
| --- | --- |
| `k3` | K3，Moderato / Plus 及以上会员可调用，Allegretto / Pro 及以上会员可解锁最高 100 万上下文；支持 `low` / `high` / `max` 三档思考强度，适合大型代码库分析、多文件重构、超长文档处理等长上下文任务。 |
| `k3-256k` | K3 256K 上下文版，Moderato / Plus 及以上会员可调用；支持 `low` / `high` / `max` 三档思考强度。256k 上下文内效果与 K3 相同，`k3`（1M）消耗约为 `k3-256k` 两倍，适合日常问答、代码补全、常规功能开发、单文件或少量文件修改场景，不支持视频输入。 |
| `kimi-for-coding` | K2.8 Preview，Andante / Plus 及以上会员可用；支持最高 1M 上下文与 `low` / `high` / `max` 三档思考强度。 |
| `kimi-for-coding-highspeed` | K2.7 Code 高速版，Allegretto / Pro 及以上会员可用。 |

模型能力与配置细节见 [模型配置](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code/models.html)
。

#### 获取 API Key [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-api-key)

Kimi 会员可在 [Kimi Code 控制台](https://www.kimi.com/code/console)
 创建和管理（最多 5 个，仅创建时显示一次，请妥善保存）。

#### 配置到第三方工具 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E5%88%B0%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%89%E6%96%B9%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7)

获取 API Key 后，将对应 Base URL 和 API Key 配置到对应工具的环境变量即可使用。详细配置步骤请参考对应工具的接入文档：

[Claude CodeAnthropic 的命令行编程助手](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/third-party-tools/claude-code)
[OpenCode终端编程 Agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/third-party-tools/opencode)
[CodexOpenAI 的编程 Agent](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/third-party-tools/codex)

> **注意**：使用时请保持工具的真实身份标识，篡改客户端标识（User-Agent）将被视为违规，可能导致会员权益暂停。

平台对比 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/#%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E5%AF%B9%E6%AF%94)

# Membership Benefits | Kimi Code Docs

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#VPContent)

On this page

Membership Benefits [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#membership-benefits)

=========================================================================================================

📢 New plans released

The new Kimi membership plans are now available, with pricing unchanged — see the [Kimi Code plan page](https://www.kimi.ai/code/#pricing)
 for plan details and pricing. For new members, **the weekly quota limit is removed**, and only the rolling 5-hour rate window remains. The Go tier has no coding quota; Plus and above can use Kimi Code. Existing subscribers on legacy plans are not affected: the tier name, quota rules, and auto-renewal all remain as they are. See the [plan comparison](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#plan-comparison)
 below for the differences between the legacy and new plans.

Overview [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#overview)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code is the developer-focused AI coding service within [Kimi membership benefits](https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing?from=kfc_docs_membership)
, provided together with a Kimi membership subscription and sharing the same quota. Requests from the CLI, VS Code, Desktop, and third-party tools all count toward that quota.

See the [Kimi membership page](https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing?from=kfc_docs_membership)
 for tiers and pricing.

Membership Tiers [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#plan-comparison)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi membership tiers have been renamed, with pricing unchanged. Here is how the new plans compare with the legacy ones:

| Item | Legacy plans | New plans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kimi Code availability | Andante and above | Plus and above |
| 5-hour rate window | Yes | Yes |
| Weekly rate window | Yes | No  |
| Monthly total quota | Yes | Yes |
| K3 access | Moderato and above | Plus and above |
| K3 1M context | Allegretto and above | Pro and above |
| HighSpeed access | Allegretto and above | Pro and above |

**FAQ**

Can I keep using my legacy plan?

Yes. Legacy plans purchased before the new plans launched remain usable. When the term ends, you can renew or upgrade to a new plan.

Do I have to upgrade to a new plan?

No — migration is optional. Your legacy plan keeps renewing as long as you stay subscribed; whether to upgrade depends on your needs.

How do I upgrade my plan?

On the [Kimi Code plan page](https://www.kimi.ai/code/#pricing)
, pick the new plan you want and click "Subscribe" to complete payment. Your current plan's remaining days are prorated automatically, and the new plan takes effect immediately.

Quota and Limits [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#quota-and-limits)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Quota rules differ between new and existing members:

*   **New members**: the weekly quota limit is removed — quota no longer refreshes every 7 days. The **rolling 5-hour rate window** still applies: too many requests in a short time trigger rate limiting, which recovers automatically once the window rolls over.
*   **Existing members on legacy plans**: rules are unchanged — quota **refreshes automatically every 7 days** from your subscription date, unused quota does not roll over, and the same 5-hour rolling rate window applies.

Both groups share the Kimi membership monthly total quota: if the monthly total is reached, Kimi Code quota is frozen until the monthly quota resets or you upgrade. Monthly usage can be viewed on the [Subscription](https://www.kimi.com/membership/subscription)
 page.

All logged-in devices and API Keys share the same quota; devices inactive for over 30 days are automatically unbound and can be restored by running `/login` again. Log in to the [Kimi Code Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/console)
 at any time to check remaining quota and rate-limit status and to manage API Keys and devices.

Extra Usage [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/membership.html#extra-usage)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When your subscription quota runs out, you can keep making requests using your Extra Usage balance without waiting for a refresh. Only subscribed members can enable it, and **Kimi on the web and Kimi Code share the same Extra Usage balance**. See the full terms in the [Extra Usage Agreement](https://www.kimi.com/user/agreement/extra-usage-rules-cn)
.

![Extra Usage](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/images/zh/kimi-code/membership/extra-usage-en.jpeg)

**Top-up entry points**

*   **From the main site**: go to the Kimi [Subscription page](https://www.kimi.com/membership/subscription?tab=quota)
    , scroll to the "Extra Usage" module at the bottom then choose an amount and complete payment.
*   **From the Kimi Code Console**: once your weekly quota (existing members on legacy plans) or 5-hour quota reaches over **80%** used, the progress card shows a **Buy Extra Usage** button that takes you to the subscription page to purchase.

![The Extra Usage entry in the Kimi Code Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/images/zh/kimi-code/membership/extra-usage-console-en.png)

**Enabling and managing**

Turn on the "Extra Usage" toggle, and when your subscription quota runs out, the system automatically deducts from your Extra Usage balance. Click **Settings** in the module to enable a **monthly spending cap** and set the maximum you can spend this month; the progress bar shows this month's Extra Usage consumption in real time.

**Billing and rules**

*   **Billing**: charged by actual usage — the more content read and generated, and the more complex the task, the higher the cost; the balance is shown in RMB, with rates as displayed on the platform. Extra Usage pricing is close to the official API pricing of the [Kimi Open Platform](https://platform.kimi.com/)
    ; for heavy usage, upgrading your subscription is usually more cost-effective.
*   **Deduction priority**: time-limited quotas such as the subscription are deducted first; **Extra Usage is deducted last** as a fallback. Once enabled, even if your subscription quota is maxed out, Extra Usage is consumed seamlessly and tasks don't stop or error out.
*   **Spending cap**: enable a "monthly spending cap" in settings to limit how much Extra Usage can be spent this month; without it, there is no cap.
*   **Validity and stacking**: the balance does not expire and stacks across top-ups; it remains usable after the subscription lapses, but you can't top up during the lapse — re-subscribe first to top up again.
*   **Refunds**: generally non-refundable, non-transferable, and non-redeemable.

> Billing example (from official examples, for a rough sense of scale; actual rates per the platform): a simple request (e.g. "recommend a rock song") costs about **¥0.03**; a complex multi-step task (e.g. "plan a week-long road trip from Chengdu to western Sichuan") costs about **¥1.6**.

> Top-up limits: minimum ¥25 per top-up, up to 10 times and ¥3,000 per day, with a balance cap of ¥10,000.

**Checking your usage**

*   **Kimi web / app**: Settings → Subscription & Invoices → [My Quota](https://www.kimi.com/membership/subscription?tab=quota)
    .
*   **Kimi Code Console**: **once Extra Usage is enabled**, log in to the [Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/console)
     to view your balance and usage.
*   **Kimi Code CLI**: type `/usage` on the command line to check directly.

![Checking Extra Usage with /usage in the CLI](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/images/zh/kimi-code/membership/extra-usage-cli.png)

**FAQ**

Do Kimi on the web and Kimi Code use the same Extra Usage wallet?

Yes. The Extra Usage balance is shared between Kimi and Kimi Code — top up once and use it in both; the Extra Usage you top up under "My Quota" and the one in the Kimi Code Console are the same balance.

Which is deducted first, Extra Usage or subscription quota?

Time-limited quotas such as the subscription are deducted first; Extra Usage is only deducted as a fallback once all time-limited quotas are exhausted.

When I hit the monthly / weekly (legacy plans) / hourly limit, or get rate-limited mid-session, can I keep going?

Yes. Once Extra Usage is enabled you're not affected by subscription limits — whenever any quota is reached it seamlessly switches to the Extra Usage balance, so tasks don't stop or error out, and only Extra Usage is deducted without affecting your membership quota refresh.

How is Extra Usage billed, and how does it compare with a same-priced subscription or Open Platform API?

Billing depends on the request's input/output volume and cache hit rate; Extra Usage pricing is close to the [Kimi Open Platform](https://platform.kimi.com/)
's official API, and for heavy usage upgrading your subscription is usually more cost-effective.

Can unused balance roll over to next month, and does it stack?

Yes — it's credit-based, doesn't expire, and stacks; it stays usable after the subscription lapses, but you can't top up during the lapse and must re-subscribe to top up again.

When the balance is nearly used up (e.g. a 25 RMB top-up), will the current request finish?

It guarantees the "last model call" completes even if its billing exceeds the limit, but it doesn't guarantee the whole task will finish.

Is Extra Usage available for Enterprise?

Not yet supported.

After I close my account, is the balance refunded?

To request a refund, go to [Kimi.ai](https://www.kimi.com/)
 on the web, click your profile picture in the bottom-left corner, then select **Get Help** → **User Feedback** to reach our support team.

# FAQ | Kimi Code Docs

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#VPContent)

On this page

FAQ [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#faq)

==================================================================

Installation and Authentication [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#installation-and-authentication)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Empty model list during `/login` [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#empty-model-list-during-login)

If you see the error "No models available for the selected platform" when running the `/login` command, it may be due to:

*   **Invalid or expired API key**: Check whether the API key you entered is correct and still valid.
*   **Network connection issues**: Confirm you can access the API service addresses (such as `api.kimi.ai` or `api.moonshot.ai`).

**Note: Distinguish Platforms**

Kimi Code membership benefits and the [Kimi Platform](https://platform.kimi.com/)
 have different Base URLs. Please ensure your Base URL and API Key are matched correctly.

| Platform | Base URL | Billing | Key Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Kimi Code** | Anthropic-compatible: China `https://api.kimi.com/coding/`  <br>Overseas `https://api.kimi.ai/coding/` | Membership subscription (quota included) | [Kimi Code Console](https://www.kimi.com/code/console) |
| **Kimi Open Platform** | China `https://api.moonshot.cn/v1`  <br>Overseas `https://api.moonshot.ai/v1` | Pay-as-you-go | [Kimi Open Platform](https://platform.kimi.com/) |

### Invalid API key [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#invalid-api-key)

Possible reasons:

*   **Typo**: Check for extra spaces or missing characters.
*   **Expired or revoked**: Verify the key status in the console.

### Membership expired or quota exhausted [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#membership-expired-or-quota-exhausted)

Use the `/usage` command to check your current quota and membership status. If your quota is exhausted or membership has expired, renew or upgrade at [Kimi Code](https://kimi.com/code)
.

Subscription [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#subscription)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### How do I request an invoice or upgrade my membership? [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#how-do-i-request-an-invoice-or-upgrade-my-membership)

Visit the [Kimi Membership page](https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing?from=kfc_docs_faq#pricing-faq)
 and follow the instructions to submit an invoice request or upgrade your plan.

Interaction Issues [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#interaction-issues)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Image paste fails [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#image-paste-fails)

If you see "Current model does not support image input" when pasting with `Ctrl-V`, the current model does not support image input.

Solutions:

*   **Switch to a vision-capable model**: Use a model with `image_in` capability.
*   **Check clipboard content**: Make sure the clipboard contains actual image data, not just a file path.

Updates and Upgrades [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#updates-and-upgrades)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Slow first launch on macOS [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#slow-first-launch-on-macos)

macOS Gatekeeper performs a security check on new programs the first time they run, causing a slow startup. Solutions:

*   **Wait for the check to complete**: Be patient on first launch; subsequent startups will be normal.
*   **Add to Developer Tools**: Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Tools and add your terminal app.

### How to upgrade Kimi Code CLI [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#how-to-upgrade-kimi-code-cli)

Run `kimi upgrade` inside the CLI to automatically check for the latest version and be guided through the upgrade. You can also use the package manager directly:

sh

    npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code@latest

VS Code Extension FAQ [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-extension-faq)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following are common questions about the Kimi Code VS Code extension.

### VS Code says no workspace is open [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-says-no-workspace-is-open)

Open a folder in VS Code — the Kimi Code VS Code extension requires a workspace to function properly.

### VS Code says CLI not found [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-says-cli-not-found)

Manually install Kimi Code CLI and configure `kimi.executablePath` in VS Code settings, or ensure the built-in CLI exists.

### VS Code login fails [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-login-fails)

Try skipping login and using API key mode instead, check your network connection, or retry later via the extension's action menu.

### VS Code shows no response after sending a message [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-shows-no-response-after-sending-a-message)

Confirm that Kimi Code CLI is available, a model is configured, and a workspace folder is open in VS Code. Check error logs via "Kimi Code: Show Logs".

### VS Code connection timeout [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-connection-timeout)

Requests time out after 30 seconds with no response. Check your network and retry.

### VS Code shows an error before sending a message [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#vs-code-shows-an-error-before-sending-a-message)

Certain errors prevent sending messages in VS Code, such as CLI not found, version too low, not logged in, or session busy. Errors appear as toast notifications; your input is preserved for retry.

Feedback and Contact [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#feedback-and-contact)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Problem not resolved by this page [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/faq.html#problem-not-resolved-by-this-page)

If the above content hasn't resolved your issue, please go to [Kimi.ai](https://www.kimi.com/)
 on the web, click your profile picture in the bottom-left corner, then select **Get Help** → **User Feedback** to consult our support team. Please describe the problem, steps taken, and any relevant logs — we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

# Kimi Code Community Guidelines | Kimi Code Docs

[Skip to content](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#VPContent)

On this page

Kimi Code Community Guidelines [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#kimi-code-community-guidelines)

=========================================================================================================================================

Kimi Code is dedicated to providing intelligent, high-performance AI coding services to users worldwide — through continuous model improvements, relentless pursuit of Agent capabilities, and a flexible Token Plan. Our goal is to shorten the distance between imagination and reality, and make AI agents accessible to everyone. To ensure every Kimi Code user has a better experience, we put forward the following guidelines.

Scope of Use [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#scope-of-use)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code subscriptions are for interactive use only. We're compatible with mainstream coding tools and agent frameworks (Kimi CLI, VS Code, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, etc.), so you can call Kimi Code's AI capabilities from the tools you already use. For enterprise integrations, commercial services, or other platform-related inquiries, visit the [Kimi Platform](https://platform.moonshot.ai/)
 to explore partnership options.

✧ Usage Guidelines We Need to Highlight [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#%E2%9C%A7-usage-guidelines-we-need-to-highlight)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To ensure everyone can continue to access stable model services, there are some usage guidelines you need to follow.

#### Don't resell your account or API access

Your account is a direct connection between you and Kimi Code. Transferring it to others also puts your own data and usage history at risk.

#### Don't resell Kimi Code's capabilities as a service

Using Kimi Code to support your own work is completely fine. Repackaging it as a product to sell to others bypasses our pricing and service structure — and isn't fair to users who play by the rules.

#### Don't spoof or alter client identity information

We rely on this information to maintain service quality and security. Impersonating or masking your client identity can make your requests behave unpredictably from the platform's perspective.

#### Don't use Kimi Code for non-interactive automation

Kimi Code subscriptions are for personal interactive use only. Using it for non-interactive purposes — such as scripted batch execution or data annotation pipelines — goes beyond normal use.

If your usage doesn't align with the guidelines above, we'll review the situation first and take appropriate action—such as **limiting concurrent access**—based on the severity. You'll then see a `You've reached your concurrent request limit` error — see the [error reference](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/error-reference.html#concurrent-request-limit)
 for details. Accordingly, if you purchase through unauthorized channels (such as resold accounts or third-party sellers), your account may be suspended upon verification, and we **will not be liable for any losses**.

Think we got it wrong?

If your account has been mistakenly suspended, please contact our support email at [support@moonshot.ai](mailto:support@moonshot.ai)
. To help us resolve your issue efficiently, please include your account ID, the time of suspension, a description of your use case, and any relevant screenshots.

♡ How We Love to See Kimi Code Used [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#%E2%99%A1-how-we-love-to-see-kimi-code-used)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kimi Code welcomes every builder who believes code can change the world — whether you're an indie developer, an open source contributor, or someone just getting started turning their first idea into a product. We especially encourage sustained, focused use. For users who maintain longer sessions and make good use of conversation history, the platform dynamically optimizes how your quota is consumed, meaning the same workload uses less of it.

Join the Community [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#join-the-community)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you'd like to connect with more like-minded Kimi Coders, join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/rGSAZtWSZg)
 and let's build together. Happy Coding!

FAQ [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/community-guidelines.html#faq)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Q1: I'm a heavy user with high daily usage. Will I get flagged by mistake?**

No. Our risk detection considers a wide range of signals. Users with normal patterns across IP address, conversation behavior, and usage metrics are not typically flagged, regardless of volume.

**Q2: Will using a VPN or corporate proxy get me suspended?**

Accessing Kimi through a forward proxy (like a VPN or company network) is fine. Sharing your account with others through a reverse proxy is a violation.

**Q3: I use Kimi Code across multiple devices and tools at the same time. Will that get me suspended?**

No. Switching between devices (e.g., work laptop, personal machine) or different coding tools (Kimi CLI, VS Code, Claude Code) is a completely normal usage pattern. You won't be mistakenly flagged as long as you don't deliberately spoof or alter your client identity.

# What's New | Kimi Code Docs

On this page

What's New [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#what-s-new)

======================================================================================

A record of new features and key fixes across Kimi Code products — focused on the changes most worth knowing about.

LatestKimi Code CLI

v2.1.0 September 23, 2026 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#v2-1-0-september-23-2026)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### Fullscreen mode (experimental) [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#fullscreen-mode-experimental)

A new experimental fullscreen interface: the transcript scrolls independently, text can be selected with the mouse, fold blocks expand or collapse on click, and a clickable "Jump to bottom" indicator sits at the bottom. Enable it under `/settings` → TUI mode, or set `tui_mode = "fullscreen"` in `~/.kimi-code/tui.toml`, then restart Kimi Code. → [tui.toml](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/config-files.html#tuitoml)

#### Faster startup, lower memory [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#faster-startup-lower-memory)

Shorter CLI startup time and reduced memory usage — first paint arrives noticeably sooner in large projects.

#### File watching is now off by default [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#file-watching-is-now-off-by-default)

Filesystem watching for config and workspace files no longer runs by default; to hot-reload AGENTS.md, skills, or MCP config, set `[watch] enabled = true` or `KIMI_CODE_WATCH=1`. → [watch](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/config-files.html#watch)

Also in this release: hardened workspace trust boundaries — file tools can no longer reach outside the working directory through symbolic links, and project-local config only takes effect after the workspace is trusted; new `auto_session_title` config to turn off automatic session title generation by clients. → [Config files](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/config-files.html#top-level-fields)

Kimi Code Desktop

Kimi Code Desktop is here September 17, 2026 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#kimi-code-desktop-is-here-september-17-2026)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kimi Code desktop client is officially available: it carries the Agent core of Kimi Code CLI into a graphical interface, where you open a project, talk to the Agent, and ship changes in one window. Available now for macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) and Windows. → [Quick Start](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-desktop/getting-started.html)

#### Every step stays visible [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#every-step-stays-visible)

Tool calls, thinking, and the files changed in each turn are all presented in the interface; sensitive operations raise approval prompts, and three permission modes (Always Ask / Ask When Needed / Never Ask) keep you in control. → [Handle approvals](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-desktop/getting-started.html#handle-approvals)

#### A complete workflow from conversation to delivery [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#a-complete-workflow-from-conversation-to-delivery)

Goal mode keeps long-running objectives moving and can be paused, resumed, or cancelled; plan mode proposes an approach before touching files, and the plan can be reviewed and refined; long tasks can move to the background, where you can check progress or stop them at any time. → [Choose a task mode](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-desktop/using-desktop.html#choose-a-task-mode)

#### Built-in browser and visual annotation [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#built-in-browser-and-visual-annotation)

The browser lives in the right panel, with tabs that stay with the session and page context shared with the Agent; screenshot annotation, text selection comments, `@` file mentions, and element picking on web pages tell the Agent exactly what to change. → [Verify in the terminal](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-desktop/using-desktop.html#verify-in-the-terminal)

Download: [macOS · Apple Silicon](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-arm64.dmg)
 · [macOS · Intel](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-mac-x64.dmg)
 · [Windows](https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/desktop/download/KimiCode-win-x64.exe)

Kimi Code CLI

v2.0.0 September 17, 2026 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#v2-0-0-september-17-2026)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### New `/desktop` command [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#new-desktop-command)

The new `/desktop` slash command (alias `/install-desktop`) and the `kimi install-desktop` subcommand open the desktop app page in your browser, so you can download and install the desktop client without leaving the terminal. → [`kimi install-desktop`](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/reference/kimi-command.html#kimi-install-desktop)

#### Mermaid diagrams in the terminal [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#mermaid-diagrams-in-the-terminal)

Mermaid code blocks now render as diagrams in the terminal; turn this off under `/settings` → Mermaid diagrams, or set `mermaid = "off"` in the `[markdown]` section of tui.toml.

Also in this release: the built-in browser plugin is renamed to Kimi Browser Extension; when accumulated media in a session exceeds 20 MB, the oldest images and videos are omitted from requests with a warning → [Paste images and videos](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/interaction.html#paste-images-and-videos)
. Since v2.0.1, a provider's API key can be read from a named environment variable via `api_key_env` instead of being written into the config file → [Config files](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/config-files.html#providers)
.

Kimi Code CLI

v0.43.0 September 14, 2026 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#v0-43-0-september-14-2026)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### AI session titles in Web, on by default [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#ai-session-titles-in-web-on-by-default)

A title is generated automatically after the first turn, and you can regenerate it from the rename box — no more naming sessions by hand.

#### Delete sessions from the session selector [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#delete-sessions-from-the-session-selector)

Select a session in the session selector, press `Ctrl-X`, then `y` to confirm — cleaning up old sessions is much easier.

#### Fairer time budgets in Goal Mode [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#fairer-time-budgets-in-goal-mode)

Time budgets no longer count the time while a session is closed, and the 24-hour cap is gone, so long-running goals no longer burn budget while you are away. → [Goal mode](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/interaction.html#goal-mode)

Also in this release: `kimi upgrade` (alias `kimi update`) gains a `-y, --yes` flag to skip the confirmation prompt; the new `KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER` environment variable (set to `0`) stops injecting auto-permission-mode reminders into the model context. v0.43.1 fixes pressing `Ctrl-C` while a subagent is running quitting the entire CLI — it now only interrupts the running subagent.

Model Release

K2.8 Preview September 11, 2026 [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#k2-8-preview-september-11-2026)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🎉 **K2.8 Preview** is now fully rolled out in Kimi Code! The Model ID is unchanged — still `kimi-for-coding` — so clients and third-party tools work with no configuration changes. → [Model configuration](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.html)

#### Performance close to K3, with more efficient thinking [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#performance-close-to-k3-with-more-efficient-thinking)

Coding and agent capabilities are improved across the board, with significantly more efficient thinking than K2.7 Code.

#### Adjustable thinking effort [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#adjustable-thinking-effort)

Same thinking levels as K3: `low` / `high` / `max` (default `max`). With thinking turned off, requests to the K3 series and K2.8 Preview are served by K2.8 Preview (no thinking).

#### 1M ultra-long context [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#_1m-ultra-long-context)

A context window of up to 1M is available across all membership tiers.

Kimi Code CLI

Remote Control is out of the experimental stage — no experimental flag needed. Take over a local session from your phone or another computer, anywhere. → [Remote Control](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/remote-control.html)

#### Sortable media preview bar in the Web input box [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#sortable-media-preview-bar-in-the-web-input-box)

Attachments appear in a sortable preview bar, so you can reference images and videos inline in your text, and previews survive queuing and sending. HEIC, HEIF, and BMP images are now supported too. → [Pasting images and video](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/interaction.html#pasting-images-and-video)

Finished tool calls now collapse into a title plus a one-line result summary, keeping the transcript clean — press `Ctrl-O` to expand the full output. → [Keyboard shortcuts](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/reference/keyboard.html#tool-output)

Also in this release: the `/btw` side-chat subagent gains read-only tools; the subagent model pool (`[secondary_model]`) is now always on and its experimental flag has been removed.

The web version adds an experimental tower multi-agent mode — enable it with the `/tower` command or the plus menu in the input box, and set the base branch with `/tower <base-branch>`.

#### Text selection annotations in Web [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#text-selection-annotations-in-web)

Select text in messages, file previews, diff and per-turn change panels, or the terminal to add a comment or quote it into the conversation.

The former YOLO / Auto modes are now Ask When Needed (`/ask-when-needed`) and Never Ask (`/never-ask`); Manual is Always Ask. A built-in dangerous-command guard also ships in this release: commands such as `shutdown`, `reboot`, or `rm -rf` are blocked outright in Never Ask mode and always require your confirmation in the other modes; disable it with `[permission] dangerous_command_guard = false`. → [Interaction & input](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/interaction.html#the-three-permission-modes)

Also in this release: Tower mode (experimental) no longer starts on its own — turn it on explicitly with `/tower on` or `/tower <base-branch>`; the new `kimi session list` command lists sessions from the command line. v0.40.1 fixes the kimi-cli migration prompt reappearing after the migration had completed or been dismissed.

Set `KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_REMOTE_CONTROL=1`, then run `kimi rc`, `kimi web --remote-control`, or `/remote-control` to access a local web session remotely. → [Remote control](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/remote-control.html)

Set `KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_TOWER=1`, then use `/tower on` and `/tower <objective>` to start Tower mode and coordinate multiple agents toward an objective.

#### Fork subagents from the current conversation [​](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/whats-new.html#fork-subagents-from-the-current-conversation)

Set `KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_SUBAGENT_FORK=1`, or `subagent_fork = true` under `[experimental]`, to let the subagent and swarm tools use `fork` to start from a snapshot of the calling agent's conversation history. → [Agents and subagents](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/customization/agents.html)

Also in this release: Configure an independent AgentSwarm timeout with `[swarm] timeout_ms` or `KIMI_CODE_SWARM_TIMEOUT_MS`; file tools and Shell now resolve Git Bash paths correctly on Windows. v0.39.1 fixes the web permission mode leaking across sessions, the first typed character being swallowed in an empty composer, and startup hanging on "Connecting…" with many workspaces, and adds a file mode to the OpenIn menu.

Type `/` after whitespace in the input to insert a skill tag — a single prompt can now activate multiple skills. Skill slash commands typed while the agent is busy are also queued instead of rejected. → [Invoking a Skill](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/customization/skills.html#invoking-a-skill)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The experimental subagent model configuration is now a model pool: list candidate models with descriptions under `[secondary_model]`, and the main agent picks one per spawn based on the task; you can also pin a default with `/secondary-model` or `default_model`. Enable it with `KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_SECONDARY_MODEL=1`. → [Subagent model pool](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/config-files.html#subagent-model-pool)
